exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Relative clauses — which, that, whose

items.prompt: The documents ___ match the LC will be paid.
items.hintAfterError: Para coisas (documents), o pronome relativo não pode ser o de pessoas nem o de posse.

items.prompt: The LC, ___ was issued last week, has three errors.
items.hintAfterError: Entre vírgulas (informação extra), 'that' não pode ser usado.

items.prompt: We contacted the buyer ___ signature was missing.
items.hintAfterError: A assinatura é DO comprador: aqui o pronome indica posse. 'Who's' = 'who is'.

items.prompt: The clause ___ requires a sanitary certificate is impossible to meet.
The issuing bank, ___ conditions are strict, rejected the presentation.
items.hintAfterError: Pronome relativo de posse, igual para pessoas e coisas.
